video.title: AI欧腐《教父的小龙崽/The Don's Dragon Heir》
video.desc:
Deep in the Alps lies the Sacred Grove, home to ancient dragons. Faced with deadly underworld erosion, silver dragon Caelan drains magic from mafia don Dante Moretti to survive, accidentally conceiving their daughter Lyra. Five years later, the ailing Caelan and sharp‑witted little Lyra head to the human world to find Dante.
阿尔卑斯山深处，坐落着古龙的家园——圣林。面对致命的幽冥侵蚀，银龙 Caelan 为了活命，从黑帮教父 Dante Moretti 身上汲取魔力——却意外怀上了两人的女儿 Lyra。
五年后，病弱的 Caelan 带着聪明伶俐的小 Lyra，前往人类世界寻找 Dante。
